summary.prose: Add impact-aware correction reviews to the existing design-review coordinator. Reviewers assess direct and indirect effects, inspect affected chunks and a fresh consistency check, and retain eligible prior coverage by reference. Strict history, finding reconciliation and visible fresh/retained progress preserve correctness while reusing S1/S2 recovery; permanent history and approval cleanup remain S4.

tasks.title: Bound impact, finding and report schemas
tasks.summary: Define additive contracts and deterministic schema fixtures before runtime integration.
acceptanceChecks: Strict sc4 assessment, source tuples, finding-decision union, preparationKind, result/report/progress and impact request schemas reject extras and enforce existing count/byte bounds.
Initial/no-impact checkpoints remain readable; correction report requires complete bounded provenance; no copied historical bodies.

tests.name: Strict impact/disposition/projection schemas reject extras, wrong branches and bounds; old full checkpoints decode

tasks.title: Admit sequential correction attempts and freeze history
tasks.summary: Extend coordinator admission and checkpoint evolution using existing subject fences and recovery gates.
acceptanceChecks: Initial attempt=1, exact historical replay and latest+1 after complete terminal report are distinct branches; submitted.attempt remains 1.
checkEvolution permits only ordinary impact correction or existing approved invalidated full restart; freezes all prior attempts and preparationKind; save failure dispatches nothing.

tests.name: Sequential admission/replay and two checkpoint-growth branches preserve history and reject invalid statuses

tasks.title: Resolve and validate immutable coverage origins
tasks.summary: Add bounded backward historical-origin resolution and retained coverage eligibility checks shared by impact validation and consolidation.
acceptanceChecks: Resolve strictly decreasing same-artifact/reviewer references to accepted substantive sources; reject cycles, forward/equal/foreign/missing/invalidated or malformed origins.
Require passed/changes_requested and empty limitations at every link; reject older-passed bypass of immediately preceding incomplete coverage; preserve prior bytes.

tests.name: Backward provenance eligibility matrix and incomplete-source bypass rejection

tasks.title: Validate current impact selection and explicit full fallback
tasks.summary: Implement proposed validateDesignImpact over full plan/inventory and validated historical origins.
acceptanceChecks: Validate full plan then disjoint complete selected/retained partition, mandatory fresh consistency and eligible strictly backward same-review origins.
Reject incomplete/limited sources, older-passed bypass, foreign/cyclic/forward/missing/invalidated origins; raw validation errors normalize only at execution boundary.
Uncertain context accepts explicit full candidate; affected_chunks is rejected within current-unit retry budget without host rewriting.

tests.name: Full-plan partition and explicit-full versus rejected-selective retry classification

tasks.title: Schedule selected work with existing recovery controls
tasks.summary: Extend nextDesignUnit/reserveDesignUnit and progress tracking for selected execution without changing S2 policy.
acceptanceChecks: Derive executionOrder by filtering complete dependency order; retained chunks make zero calls; final consistency remains fresh; completedChunks is a fresh prefix.
Reserve current.kind=impact for impact preparation and use same kind in interrupted matching; reject preparation mismatch before mutations.
Preserve retry counters, explicit recovery, subject-only invalidation/late-generation fences and active-tool/30-minute inactivity controls; raw stored-state errors remain terminal.

tests.name: Interleaved selected order and impact reservation kind
Selected work resume/mutation/generation and persisted retry counters

tasks.title: Run impact preparation on native and controller routes
tasks.summary: Add designImpactPrompt and coordinator impact exchange/execute branches with shared validation and atomic accepted plan+impact.
acceptanceChecks: Native and trusted controller use identical impact policy/schema and atomically persist plan+impact before chunk dispatch.
Derive executionOrder from complete plan, skip retained chunks with zero provider calls, set impact current.kind and preserve reservation/recovery generation fences.
Use existing initial+three retries, explicit directed recovery, real activity/tool tracking and subject-only invalidation; no new timeouts or auto next attempt.

tests.name: Native/controller impact exchange parity and atomic plan-plus-impact save

tasks.title: Reconcile findings and consolidate effective coverage
tasks.summary: Extend result assessment and consolidation while preserving all-fresh behavior.
acceptanceChecks: Exact F=S, S disjoint R and S union R=P; fresh-only result bodies, valid retained origins and complete inventory coverage.
Extract decisions solely from accepted fresh final consistency result; missing reconciliation carries unresolved findings and produces incomplete.
Deduplicate findings by immutable source tuple, validate resolved/superseded evidence, compute effective counts and exact report.impact projection; no second disposition argument.

tests.name: Exact coverage partition and effective finding counts
Final-result-only decisions, missing reconciliation carry, resolved/superseded evidence

tasks.title: Expose impact transport and truthful progress
tasks.summary: Update public registrations, observation and workflow guidance to expose implemented S3 semantics.
acceptanceChecks: Register impact through normal MCP, daemon RPC, handler routing, method class and repo audit with trusted owner/generation/sequence checks.
Progress total is selected executionOrder length, completed is fresh accepted count; separately report retained/effective breakdown; paginate fresh results only.
Existing no-impact callers stay valid; polling never dispatches work and complete fraction never masks incomplete status.

tests.name: Normal impact schema/IPC routing rejects foreign or stale submissions
Fresh-only progress pagination and retained breakdown

tasks.title: Qualify S3 across workflow contexts and compiled entrypoints
tasks.summary: Finish scoped integration qualification and maintain relevant design/sequence documentation.
acceptanceChecks: Deterministic native/controller scenarios cover Epic/Standalone/Issue contexts, indirect dependencies, provenance chains, missing decisions, mutations and interrupted/paused recovery.
Disposable compiled fake-CLI MCP/IPC smoke proves full initial then selective corrected review, zero retained calls, truthful progress and blocker carry; label synthetic evidence.
Run production build and scoped regression suites once; keep S4 publication/approval/cleanup and installed-daemon rollout out of this story.

Verify corrupt trusted provenance, checkpoint-cap/persistence failure, owner/generation errors and candidate bounds have the documented terminal-versus-output-retry behavior. Re-run relevant all-fresh S1/S2 and code-review regression subsets.

tests.name: Disposable compiled MCP/IPC initial and corrected review call counts
Epic standalone issue contexts and S1/S2 regression qualification

testStrategyCoverage.lldStrategyItem: Impact {plan,impact} envelope round-trips; missing/extra fields, byte/count limits and positive sequential attempt constraints reject without dispatch.
Complete current plan and selected/retained partition: no omitted/duplicate/unknown chunk, all consistency fresh, no unsafe split/merge retention, same artifact/reviewer backward-only sources.
Finding tuple identities and explicit dispositions: duplicate IDs across attempts/chunks do not conflate; unknown/resolved/superseded references reject or remain incomplete.
Direct correction selects edited concern and indirect dependent chunks even when their text is unchanged; final consistency always executes.
Uncertainty, missing usable baseline, incompatible grouping or reviewer-party change produces explicit full mode without retained results.
Retained coverage remains references to immutable accepted source; full report counts include carried HIGH/MED/LOW and unresolved mandatory limits; no copied-as-fresh chunks.
Fresh final consistency must account for all prior effective findings; carry by default, evidence-backed resolution and supersession require selected inspection, including removed sections.
Atomic accepted plan+impact and prior attempt immutability; failed saves preserve last accepted bytes and dispatch zero further work.

Interleaved retention: full plan [keep-A, change-B, keep-C, final], completed fresh [change-B] selects final; out-of-order/duplicate fresh results reject, retained dependencies resolve by ID and receive zero dispatches. [[c6]]

Final findingDecisions strict union round-trip, missing/foreign/duplicate origins, branch-specific required fields, nonfinal rejection, unresolved carry on missing evidence, and valid resolved/superseded evidence references. [[c5]] [[c9]]

Selective consolidation exact partition: [keep-A, change-B, keep-C, final] accepts fresh [change-B, final] with retained A/C, and rejects absent C, duplicate/unknown origins, fresh/retained overlap or retained final; report.chunks remains fresh-only. Full mode and no-impact calls retain all-fresh behavior. [[c5]] [[c6]]

Incomplete retention rejection: a structurally identical prior chunk with status incomplete or nonempty limitations must be selected afresh on native and controller routes; reject bypass via an older passed source or an incomplete provenance link. Complete sibling chunks in an overall-incomplete prior report remain eligible. If fresh review still cannot verify mandatory coverage, keep the new report incomplete. [[c5]] [[c9]]

Every same-attempt marker mutation (planning to impact, impact to planning, explicit to absent, absent to explicit) rejects before save; accepted impact rewrite/removal or a half plan/impact pair rejects while previous checkpoint bytes stay unchanged. [[c3]] [[c9]]

Native/controller candidates invoke the same proposed validateDesignImpact and extended assessDesignResult contracts; output errors use the failed unit's retry budget, wrong-owner/transport and invalid stored-state errors do not. Missing final reconciliation is incomplete with conservative carry, never a fabricated resolution. [[c4]] [[c5]] [[c13]]

Retained-source rejection matrix at validateDesignImpact AND consolidation: reject forward or equal attempt link, a cycle, cross-artifact or cross-reviewer source, missing source attempt, missing/malformed source result, and invalidated source attempt; verify prior bytes unchanged and no false consolidated coverage. Model-candidate errors use impact retries, already accepted corrupt state stops without model retry. [[c1]] [[c3]] [[c5]] [[c13]]

Reservation preparationKind mismatch matrix: planning argument on an impact attempt, impact argument on a planning/missing-marker attempt, and omitted default-planning argument on an impact attempt all reject invalid_checkpoint before counters/actions/current change and with zero provider calls. Matching preparation kinds and regular chunk reservations remain valid. [[c6]] [[c9]] [[c13]]

Selective progress live/stored/native/controller: plan [keep-A, change-B, keep-C, final] shows fresh 1/2 then 2/2 with retained2, effective3/4 then4/4; full attempts preserve N/N with retained0; pre-plan omits breakdown; count bounds and cursor fresh-only semantics reject bad state/request without a model call. An incomplete final report still shows status incomplete even when all selected assessments returned. [[c6]] [[c9]] [[c14]]

Corrupt stored checkpoint JSON/schema is terminal invalid_checkpoint with no rewrite or retry; readable valid history with semantic uncertainty selects a full review only through valid admission. [[c3]] [[c13]]

Report.impact strict schema and projection: initial/pre-S3/full-restart report omits it; selective and correction-full reports require every declared field. Verify complete fresh/retained coverageOrigins, matching sc4/final-output fields, effective finding deduplication/counts, resolved/superseded exclusion, and carry+incomplete when reconciliation is missing. Reject partial objects, extra fields, wrong origin/justification, duplicate tuples and bounds overflow without silent truncation. [[c3]] [[c5]] [[c9]]

Distinguish reviewer output bound failures (current-unit retries then pause) from a checkpoint serialization cap failure (checkpoint_too_large terminal, zero automatic retries or later dispatch, prior bytes unchanged). Verify failed cannot use recover/resume or restart_full; if terminal persistence fails, uncertainty remains visible. Use disposable deterministic fixtures, not hosted model calls. [[c3]] [[c4]] [[c9]] [[c13]]

Round-7 correction cases: impact reservation and interrupted matching use current.kind=impact, while ordinary planning and chunk reservations retain their kinds; mismatches mutate nothing. Assert raw invalid_plan/invalid_result/invalid_schema/invalid_json/input_too_large at validator/decode boundaries and normalized invalid_output at the reviewer-execution diagnostic boundary. Stored-state invalid_checkpoint/foreign_checkpoint/result_too_large/invalid_checkpoint_path/invalid_project/invalid_review_id remain terminal with no model retry, and original bytes remain unchanged. [[c3]] [[c5]] [[c6]] [[c9]] [[c13]]

Consolidation has no separate findingDecisions input: extract only the accepted final consistency result array; verify report.impact equality, and omission yields [] with unresolved carry and incomplete. A forged second copy cannot override the accepted final result. [[c5]] [[c9]]

Uncertain/unusable comparison context accepts an explicit full-mode candidate without retry, but rejects an affected_chunks candidate with raw invalid_plan/invalid_result normalized to invalid_output and spends only the current impact-unit retry budget. The host never silently transforms candidate scope or creates another attempt. [[c5]] [[c13]]
Explicit next-attempt admission after terminal complete review; exact replay, conflicting identity, active/paused/invalidated paths and no automatic next attempt.
Both reviewer parties use identical impact schema/guidelines; selected units execute in dependency order, retained units make zero model calls, complete final consistency and visible provenance.
Impact crash/transport/schema failure preserves accepted work, spends at most initial+three per impact unit, pauses for user direction and resumes with no extra accepted-unit calls.
Mutation during blocked impact, selective execution and final save latches invalidation; restoration cannot revive; approved restart_full reviews every chunk without reuse.
Epic DEF/HLD/Story LLD versus standalone and ISSUE-rooted LLD resolve correct current context without invented upstream artifacts; external changes do not trigger invalidation.

Admission branch matrix: initial attempt1; exact historical replay after later attempts; latest+1 after each terminal complete report; skipped/unknown ordinal, different artifact, active subject, uncertain storage, paused/interrupted/invalidated/failed predecessor rejection. Original submitted.attempt stays1, all prior attempt bytes freeze, current baseline is fresh; save failure dispatches zero. [[c3]] [[c4]]

Checkpoint evolution accepts terminal-complete sequential impact append and separately accepts invalidated+approved full restart; cross-branch preparationKind, changed prior prefix, missing report, changed initial submission and skipped attempt reject. [[c3]]

Controller/native impact parity: phase impact/kind impact accepts the same complete plan+sc4 decision and commits them together before acknowledgement; plan/impact or impact/planning mismatches, foreign owners, stale generations/sequences, replay conflicts and malformed envelopes reject with the existing retry distinction. Normal MCP phase schema, unary RPC route and main-owner classification/audit stay in lockstep. [[c4]] [[c9]]

Extend compiled disposable fake-CLI MCP/IPC smoke: full first review, corrected artifact, indirect impact, retained coverage, fresh consistency and auditable finding carry/resolution; inspect recorded call counts/provenance.
Typecheck/production build plus scoped design-review/MCP/schema/recovery regressions; existing code-review remains unaffected. S4 owns full approval/permanent-history/live rollout qualification.
